h: 只需一个简单的 comfyui 工作流程即可从给定图像一次性生成各种控制网络掩码（分段除外）。结果保存在输出文件夹中名为 cn-masks 的子文件夹下，您可能需要手动创建它。

o.en: Just a simple comfyui workflow to generate all kinds of controlnet masks (except for segmentations) from a given image in one go. Results are saved in your output folder under a subfolder named cn-masks, you might need to manually create it.
